images.prompt: Create an original natural color overhead photograph of exactly three separate botanical specimens lying on plain pale linen: one long fern frond at left angled upward, one single fan-shaped ginkgo leaf at upper right, and one eucalyptus twig with several attached rounded leaves at lower right. Leave visible linen gaps between all three specimens. Gentle daylight from the upper-left produces small realistic contact shadows. Fresh natural green foliage, detailed veins and a neutral linen weave, ordinary photographic exposure and color. The complete fern tip, all stems and the full fabric surface remain inside the composition. No vase, hands, labels, notebook, decorative objects or loose extra leaves. Vertical 4:5 image, exactly 1024x1280 pixels. No lettering, logo, watermark, border or stylized blue tint; this is an unprocessed source photograph.
